General & Multi-Discipline · Revit Add-in

Selection by Parameter

Pick one element. Select the matching values.

Use a sample element to find available instance parameters and select every visible element in the active view with the value you choose.

Request Demo on WhatsApp Compare Workflows
Key features

Turn a value you can see into a selection you can use

Find doors with a particular mark, beams with a shared connection value, or other elements carrying the same project parameter. The selection stays within the active view.

  • 01

    Pick & Learn

    Click any element in the model to instantly display all its available instance parameters

  • 02

    Unique Value Discovery

    Choose a parameter to retrieve all its unique existing values in the current view without duplicates

  • 03

    Instant Smart Selection

    Select a value and click Filter to automatically select all elements with the same parameter value in the active view

  • 04

    Active View Scope

    Searches only within visible elements in the current view (not the entire project) for high precision and fast performance

  • 05

    All Data Types Supported

    Seamlessly handles and processes text, integers, doubles, and Element IDs, converting them to searchable string values

  • 06

    Alphabetical Sorting

    Automatically sorts parameters and values alphabetically for fast and easy access

Illustrative time comparison

Selecting elements by an instance parameter value

Uses an existing value in the active view. Each timing includes checking that the resulting selection is the intended group. These are planning estimates. Actual times depend on the model and setup.

One door mark selection

Manual in Revit

4–8 min

Find the mark, gather matching doors, and verify the selection.

Selection by Parameter

15–30 sec

Pick a sample, choose Mark and its value, then check the selection.

3.5–7.75 min estimated savings

Five parameter selections

Manual in Revit

15–30 min

Repeat the search or schedule filtering for five coordination selections.

Selection by Parameter

1–2 min

Use the value picker for each pass and verify the matching elements.

13–29 min estimated savings
